case: Alex Murdaugh — Maggie and Paul Murdaugh retrial
court: South Carolina Court of General Sessions, Sumter County, SC
status: The venue question is resolved: on September 8, 2026 the court ordered the retrial transferred from Colleton County to Sumter County. A defense request to dismiss the indictments has not been heard and remains pending.
